Name: Vegan Fish
Author: CacklingxCaracal
Description:
Inspired by a conversation in the SDV Modding Discord - what if fish, but vegan? Where the point of catching the fish isn't to eat it, but to sustainably harvest the non-meat resources that they drop/shed naturally in fish ponds. Currently only have one recipe but I plan to expand and add more types of fish and recipes. If you have any issues please share as much detail as you can as well as your SMAPI log! 

Includes: Tofufish, TempehFish, Jackfruit Jellyfish, Seitan Squid, Chicken of the Sea, Banana Blossom Fish, and CashewCheese Sea Monkey.

Also includes 20 new recipes!
